texts: Numbers stream by one at a time — tap GO on every number, but hold your response when the stop number appears.

Numbers appear one at a time. Tap GO for every number — but when the stop number shows up, do nothing and let it pass. It is fast and repetitive on purpose: the challenge is staying alert the whole way through and holding your finger when the stop number appears.
